name: Spitify
subtitle: Your music, podcasts & audiobooks
description: Official source for Spitify, a Spotify-style player for the music on your phone.

apps.name: Spitify
apps.subtitle: Spotify-style player for your own music
apps.localizedDescription: Play the music, podcasts and audiobooks on your iPhone with playlists made for you, learned on the device. Synced lyrics, crossfade, a 10-band EQ, free LibriVox audiobooks, automatic artwork and tag fixing, and themes. No account, no ads.

privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: Spitify can play the songs already downloaded in your Music library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a profile picture or custom artwork.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Swipe a song right to add it to the queue, with haptic feedback and a brief confirmation.
- Queue buttons now confirm how many songs were added. Unsupported files and a player that is still connecting get a clear message.
- The player shows the current audio output, such as Phone speaker or the headphone name reported by your phone.
- Opening a podcast search result no longer follows it. Tap Follow when you want to add it to Your shows.
- Unfollowing a podcast keeps its cached episode details and downloads.
- Keep scrolling artist and album artwork inside its frame, fixing the exposed strip below the artist photo.

Includes the Monochrome music downloads and Android icon change from 1.0.6.

Android release build and unit tests passed. iPhone unit tests passed, including a check of podcast follow/unfollow behaviour. Physical-phone gestures, haptics and Bluetooth route names still need a device check.

The Android APK is attached. GitHub builds and attaches the iPhone IPA after publication, then updates SideStore.

The mapping text file is for decoding Android crash reports; you do not need it to install the app.

- Search for songs and albums under Search → Online on Android and iPhone.
- Download music from Monochrome into your library for offline playback.
- Downloads use Wi-Fi by default, keep a saved queue, and support cancellation and retries.
- Replace Android's layered launcher icon with the complete colour image to address the white icon reported on Fold8. This still needs confirmation on that phone.
- Remove the stats shortcut beside Android Home's filters. Your stats remain available in the profile/settings area.

Includes the latest crash fixes from 1.0.5.

The Android APK is attached. The iPhone IPA will be attached by the release workflow; SideStore updates when that build finishes.

The mapping text file helps decode Android crash reports. You do not need it to install the app.

- Fixes the app icon showing as a blank white square on Samsung phones

Includes everything from 1.0.4 (the crash-on-launch fix and built-in crash reports).

- **Fixes the app crashing every time it opens** once your music library loads (anything over a few dozen songs could trigger it)
- If Spitify ever crashes again, the next launch shows a "Send crash report" button, so it can be fixed quickly
- Settings › Help › Send problem report

`Spitify-1.0.4-mapping.txt` is for decoding crash reports; you don't need to download it.

Includes everything from 1.0.3.

- Profile pictures (and custom album art) are no longer sideways
- Fixed the app crashing right after setup when choosing a photo taken with the phone's camera (high-resolution photos ran it out of memory)

Includes everything from 1.0.2.

Fixes 1.0.1 closing itself / "Spitify is crashing frequently" after swiping it away from Recents. Swiping away still stops the music; reopening picks up where you left off.

Includes everything from 1.0.1.

- Swiping Spitify away from Recents now stops the music (Android)
- Daily Mix filler removed; a calmer, less cluttered Home
- Rows never show half-cut artwork or text
- Smoother transitions between the two halves of the Fold8 split view
- Portrait: tap the mini player to open the full player
- Lyrics are fetched automatically when you're online (no more "Search lyrics")

The iPhone IPA is attached automatically by CI once it finishes building; SideStore picks the update up from the source.
